latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of EditorJS Highlight — fast, AI-powered highlight detection and export for video clips.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and request automatic key moment extraction via chat prompts.
- Automatically authenticates using a free NEMO_TOKEN (100 credits, 7 days).
- Cloud backend processes highlight detection and exports 1080p MP4 clips in about 1–2 minutes.
- Supports direct keyword actions: upload, export, check credits/status.
- No manual scrubbing or editing—just describe what you want and receive ready-to-post video highlights.
